## 🟦 **Boston Red Sox Summary**

- The Red Sox finished as a wild-card team in the **2008 season**, winning **95 games**, and were defeated in the **ALCS by the Tampa Bay Rays in seven games**.
- In **2009**, they again qualified as a **95-win wild-card team**, but lost **3–0 to the Los Angeles Angels in the ALDS**.
- In both **2010 and 2011**, the Red Sox missed the postseason despite winning **89 and 90 games**, respectively.
- The **2011 season** saw the Red Sox hold a **nine-game lead in the wild card standings** heading into September, but lost **13 of their final 20 games**, resulting in missing the playoffs.
- This poor finish led to the **dismissal of manager Terry Francona**, marking the end of an era for Red Sox baseball.
- By their next championship in **2013**, the team had both a **new general manager** and a **new manager** (implying a rebuild and transition).

## 🟨 **Colorado Rockies Summary**

### 🎉 "Rocktober"
- The Rockies' World Series run in **2007** was nicknamed **"Rocktober"**, a portmanteau of the team name and October.

### 🏆 Playoff Appearances
- The Rockies made the **World Series in 2007**, which was their **only World Series berth** in the first 15 seasons after that.
- In **2009**, they won a wild-card berth after winning **92 games**, but lost in **four games to the Philadelphia Phillies** in a rematch of the 2007 NLDS.
- Between **2010 and 2017**, the Rockies never finished higher than **third place in the NL West**.
- In **2017**, they returned to postseason play as a **second wild-card team**, losing in the **Wild Card Game to the Arizona Diamondbacks**.
- In **2018**, the Rockies made **consecutive postseason appearances for the first time in team history**:

- In **2009**, after losing in the NLDS, the Rockies **fired Clint Hurdle** and replaced him with **Jim Tracy**.
- After managing the Rockies, **Clint Hurdle was hired by the Pittsburgh Pirates in 2011**.
- Under Hurdle, the Pirates ended a **20-year drought without a winning season** and made the **postseason three consecutive years**, including winning the **2013 National League Wild Card Game**.
